details.value: Secondary: capable, but the 20-foot/200-hp package is likely near the Maverick's practical limit and is uncommon in the region.

details.label: Notes
details.value: The early 1997-1998 Hawk 200 FS is a narrower 19'6-inch, 88-inch-beam hull around 1,245 lb. Published weight jumps to 1,560 lb in 1999, and the 2000-2001 version is 19'8 inches with a 98-inch beam at 1,550-1,580 lb. This is not one unchanging five-year hull. It remains Secondary because a fully rigged package can consume most of the Maverick's tow rating.
